author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಾಲರವಿ ತಾನುದಿಸಿ ಬಾನಿನಲಿ ಉರಿಯುತಲೆ
ಕಾಲಕಳೆಯುತ ಸಂಜೆ ಕರಗಿ ಹೋಗುವನು
ಮೇಲರಿಮೆ ತೋರುತಲೆ ಜನಗಳನು ಧಿಕ್ಕರಿಸೆ
ಸೋಲ ಕಾಣುವೆ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The young sun rises and blazes across the sky,
yet as time passes it melts away at dusk;
if you show off your superiority and scorn people,
you will meet defeat, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Even the blazing sun sets by evening. Pride that looks down on others will likewise end in a fall.
